name: @nexus/agent
description: For an agent that holds its own key: a library that reads and writes the encrypted Nexus vault by note path, and the nexus-agent command a person runs to set the vault up and approve the agent. The library is built to one file that runs in Node and in a Cloudflare Worker.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.cli.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json
